parts:
Reproducible code?


On Thursday, 30 May 2013 21:10:29 UTC+1, Ted Benson wrote:
Hi ggplot2 community,

I have the following code:

ggplot(pps, aes(x=Var1, y=value, fill=Var2), xlab="FO") 
   + geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack", width=0.2) 
   + xlab("Data Shape") 
   + ylab("Percentage Share") 
   + scale_fill_discrete(name="Data Format") 
   + coord_flip() 
   + opts(plot.margin = unit(c(1,1,1,1), "cm"))

Which produces the attached image. My problem is that I would like a short, wide chart area, but ggplot insists on giving me a very all chart that is predominantly whitespace, with two skinny bars in it. How do I tell ggplot that I only want, at most, about 1cm of whitespace as padding around the bars? (i.e., shrink the chart area to match the size of the bars)

Thanks for your help!
Ted
